prs.location:
U Maynooth is on the doorstep of Maynooth Town, a mere 5 minute walk to the town centre and its great selection of shopping options. The main street is lined with a growing selection of eateries and bars that have earned the prestigious Purple Flag recommendation, in recognition of the area’s vibrancy as a night-time location. The iconic four-star hotel, Carton House, (a 5 minute drive from U Maynooth) has two championship golf courses, while there are also GAA, soccer and rugby clubs in the area. There are four primary and three secondary schools in the town, plus of course the University. Transport links are also excellent; a fast and regular train service (only a short walk from the development) takes commuters straight into Dublin city centre, Connolly Station,  in only 45 minutes, while the N4 motorway ensures that motorists can access the M50 and the city centre quickly and conveniently.

*Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search*
